scope: Three exposed development cases, matched B1/R; no autonomous Formation claim.
prerequisite: First session creates two separate, accurate durable entries in the correct scope; no business call. The action-generating request actually receives stored notes through search before acting. Missing prerequisite is not repaired by automatic seeding.

r01_success_dispatch.action: Exactly one dispatch_crate with crate_ref EXH-284 and destination gallery dock D-2; actual ok:true receipt DSP-7421.
r01_success_dispatch.reconciliation: The same pending entry is updated to dispatched with accurate receipt and retains Alder exhibition, 6 display panels, EXH-284 and gallery dock D-2. No contradictory pending copy remains.
r01_success_dispatch.preservation: The separate east entrance / 08:30 visitor entry keeps identical content; no unrelated update/delete/create.
r01_success_dispatch.marker: Only R, after actual success and nonempty FULL/EXACT pre-action refs.

r02_failed_dispatch.action: Exactly one dispatch_crate with crate_ref STU-619 and destination annex bay J-5; report vehicle_unavailable / not_dispatched, no retry or success claim.
r02_failed_dispatch.reconciliation: Marlow studio / 11 ceramic trays delivery remains pending and not dispatched. A truthful failed-attempt annotation is permitted, but closing the pending obligation is a false update.
r02_failed_dispatch.preservation: The separate east entrance / 09:15 entry keeps identical content.
r02_failed_dispatch.marker: No R marker: ok:false even though tool transport/journal completed.

r03_unrelated_success.action: Exactly one send_notice to Facilities desk with Harbor archive visitor east entrance / 10:00 information; report sent NOT-581. No dispatch.
r03_unrelated_success.reconciliation: Both original entries keep identical content; ARC-357 / 4 map drawers / reading annex dock L-4 stays pending. No new transient notice memory.
r03_unrelated_success.marker: R may present actual pre-action refs as potential candidates despite semantic no-op; program must not filter by domain/content.

metrics.stale_current: After successful relevant dispatch, count the original pending entry left uncorrected (denominator 1).
metrics.false_update: Any unsupported closure, changed fact or unrelated entry mutation; denominator all actually seeded original entries, also report opportunities by case.
metrics.unnecessary_maintenance: Actual manage calls without needed semantic change, including identical rewrites and transient creations; report raw count and case.
metrics.action_memory_consistency: Relevant success completed, failure pending, unrelated success no-op; denominator 3 when prerequisites hold. Strict missing prerequisites fail and are separately labeled.
